judge.rationale: Agreement is limited to a common KCNQ5/FXYD6 conductance–pump core with partial overlap on KCNMB4, other K+ channels, GABRD, and subtype or morphology markers, while more than half of the full explanatory inventories—especially tonic GABA, lineage, cytoskeletal, and signaling contributors—differ, invoking the shared-minority ceiling of 4.
